PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>

ASK WHERE {
  ?man a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       rdfs:label ?manLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?manLabel), "coating"))
  ?man iof-core:describedBy ?desc .
  ?desc a sdk:BusinessDescription .
  ?desc iof-scro:hasTextValue ?descText .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?naics ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(?org) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?org sdk:hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier ?naics .
  ?org sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?naics ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?naics DESC(?manufacturerCount)
LIMIT 5

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?name
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?name .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasProcessCapability ?pc .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?mc . }
}
GROUP BY ?manufacturer ?name
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?pc) = 2 && COUNT(DISTINCT ?mc) = 2)
